name: Yakkido
source:
A slaver who runs a brothel in a frontier fortress, he is a small man with a broad, fat body.

His fat, flabby face is so vulgar that he is described as having a “smile like a crushed leech".

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/selicia/index.html]official site[/url]]
